title: Act: Confirm Tick open and close dispatch against the injected clock
summary: Keep the Tick switch cases for SCHEDULED open and OPEN close using Clock.Now()
description: Scheduler.Tick already dispatches Open and Close using clock.Now(). This unit keeps that code correct: the boundary comparison uses !now.Before so a time equal to StartsAt or EndsAt counts as due. No behavior change is expected unless the Verify unit finds a mismatch.
acceptance_criteria: Given a SCHEDULED round with StartsAt not after the clock, when Tick runs, then Controller.Open is called.
Given an OPEN round with EndsAt not after the clock, when Tick runs, then Controller.Close is called.

preserve: Public API of the round package

steps.action: Check that the case for StatusScheduled uses !now.Before(rd.StartsAt) and calls s.Controller.Open(ctx, worldID, rd.ID, OpenOptions{}), and the case for StatusOpen uses !now.Before(rd.EndsAt) and calls s.Controller.Close(ctx, worldID, rd.ID). Change nothing if both hold.
steps.code: case rd.Status == StatusScheduled && !now.Before(rd.StartsAt): ... case rd.Status == StatusOpen && !now.Before(rd.EndsAt): ...
steps.expected: The two switch cases match the snippet and go build ./internal/round/ succeeds.
